resource: Longest hold of a character name's new holder behind an undelivered vacating publication or an unsettled name handoff (the old holder's World's world_online snapshot)
allocation_impact: No allocation. A held profile stays queued; after the hold it is sent, so a rename cycle cannot hold delivery forever, and Platform answers a name with two holders as unknown (section 7.3). One game_public_name_handoffs row per vacate; the scan deletes it once settled or older than the hold.
boundary_tests: apps/game-server/tests/support/public_projections_postgres_cases.rs: a simple name handoff waits for the vacating row; a rename cycle waits only for the bounded hold; after the vacating row is delivered the new holder still waits until its handoff is settled, and a handoff older than the hold no longer holds; a resync clears every vacated name key

apps/game-server/src/native_admission_source/public_projections_tests.rs a_scan_settles_only_name_handoffs_platform_has_seen: a handoff is settled only for a World acknowledged at the cut, unchanged and acknowledged, or without a snapshot, or once older than the hold
notes: Contract sections 7.3, 8 and 11. Measured from the vacating outbox row's created_at, and from the name handoff's vacated_at, on the database clock. Internal Game-to-Platform boundary; no client wire. Registered by OTV2-20261015-public-projections-producer.
